Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.mfa

Class SecondFactorController

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.mfa.SecondFactorController
All Implemented Interfaces:
SecondFactorPageApi
@Controller public class SecondFactorController extends Object implements SecondFactorPageApi
Serves the second-factor page, as the contract apis/auth-server/web-pages/auth-server-pages-v1.yaml describes it through the generated SecondFactorPageApi, supplying the ordered fragments of the second factors, the model attributes each of them contributes for the signed-in user and the outcome of the last attempt to the template.
